The '''Climbing Boot and Glove Set''' was a set boots and gloves sold by [[SureGrip]] for climbing purposes. Like [[Climbsuit/Legends|Climbsuits]], the gloves and boots were coated in [[FrictionGrip/Legends|FrictionGrip]] to ensure a superior hold when climbing up steep surfaces. The set was popular for recreational mountain climbers, although it also saw use by [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] [[Infiltrators/Legends|Infiltrators]].<ref name="ROE" />
